classifier_node: Classify Final Measured Word Count Retry Failure
router_node: Route Final Measured Word Count Compliance Retry
root_cause: The classifier only reads $json.error when it is an object. In execution 9687 n8n supplied $json.error as a string, so errorObject became empty, message became empty, compliance_retry was false, and the existing bounded compliance retry branch was skipped.
fix_scope: M5 classifier input normalization only. Accept string or object error representations; do not broaden the eligible retry condition beyond the existing final measured word-count too-far-from-target class.
next_step: Add regression for string-form n8n error, update classifier to normalize string/object error payloads, run focused/full tests, then checkpoint before M5-only deploy.
